privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data AnycastStudio collects, why, and how long it is kept.

sections.title: 1. What we collect
items: Account: email address and a password hash.
Connected platforms: account ID, display name, avatar and the access tokens YouTube, TikTok, Instagram* or X issue when you connect them. Tokens are stored encrypted.
Content: videos, covers, titles, descriptions and publishing settings you add.
Technical data: IP address and browser details in server logs.

sections.title: 2. Why
items: To sign you in and keep the session.
To publish your content to the platforms you connected, on your command.
To keep the service secure: limit sign-in attempts and investigate failures.

sections.title: 3. Cookies and browser storage
items: sessionid: keeps you signed in, up to 14 days.
csrftoken: protects forms from forged requests.
Local storage keeps the theme, language, time zone and an unfinished upload. It stays in your browser.
No analytics or advertising cookies.

sections.title: 4. Who receives data
items: Only the platforms you connected and only what you publish to them: Google (YouTube), TikTok, Meta* (Instagram*), X.
We do not sell data or share it for advertising.

sections.title: 5. How long we keep it
items: Account and connected platforms: until you delete them.
Unfinished uploads: up to 6 hours. Media that no draft or publication uses is deleted automatically.
Server logs: up to 30 days.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
items: You can request a copy, correction or deletion of your data: write to <mail/>.
You can disconnect a platform at any time; its tokens are deleted. You can also revoke access in the platform's own settings.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: AnycastStudio is a service for publishing your videos to several platforms at once. By using it, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: 1. General terms
text: 1.1. You create the content you publish and are fully responsible for it, including following the rules of each platform.
1.2. Keep your password secret: actions under your account are considered yours.
1.3. We do not review content in advance, but may delete it and restrict access to an account that breaks these terms, without notice.

sections.title: 2. Prohibited content and actions
text: You may not publish or distribute through the service:
items: illegal content of any kind;
sexual content and any 18+ content;
insults, threats, harassment, discrimination and hate speech;
content that breaks the rules of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram* or X;
content that infringes copyright or related rights;
personal data of third parties without their consent;
malware, malicious links and exploits;
spam, artificial boosting of views, likes or comments, bots;
attempts to bypass, test or break the protection of the service or platforms, or to access other people's accounts.

sections.title: 3. Service
text: 3.1. The service is provided as is. Platforms may reject or remove a publication by their own rules.
3.2. We may change these terms; the date above shows the current version.

sections.title: 4. Privacy
text: What we collect and why is described in the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
You can request deletion of your data by writing to <mail/>.
